claim: Patchline ships audience-tailored conference demo scripts for Datadog, Microsoft RISE, database, and programming-languages audiences, each built entirely from reproducible gate commands so a presenter can run the demo live with zero risk of a broken slide. Every demo declares an audience, a focus, and an ordered list of steps where each runnable step is a real make gate target; the worker renders a presenter script with timing and talking points per step. The gate proves all four mandated audiences are present and that every runnable demo step maps to a real gate target.
real_repo: patchline (self): demo steps validated against scripts/*-gate.sh

demos.focus: Static data-change risk corroborated by real observability exports.
Deterministic, provenance-carrying analysis with bounded, quarantined generation.
Destructive migrations across nine ecosystems plus NoSQL and pipelines.
A uniform fact layer, delta-debugging minimizers, and gate-backed reproducibility.
